statement: Let k be a global function field, let J/k be a separable quadratic extension, and let F/k be separable of degree m ≥ 3. Suppose that the Galois group of the joint normal closure of F and J is Sm × C2 under its natural action on the m embeddings of F and its restriction to J. Put E = FJ. Then T = ker  ResF/k Res1 E/F Gm  NE/J − − − − → Res1 J/k Gm  (4.1) is a torus. Every torsor under T that has a point over every completion of k has a k-point, and its k-points are dense in the product of its points over any finite set of completions. In particular, let h ∈ F× and d ∈ J× satisfy NF/k(h) = NJ/k(d). If the equations NE/F (a) = h, NE/J (a) = d (4.2) 16 have a solution in (E ⊗k kv)× for every place v, they have a solution in E× approximating any prescribed local solutions at finitely many places.
